newsitem.title: USA: Alumax in talks to buy Eduard Hueck.
newsitem.headline: Alumax in talks to buy Eduard Hueck.

text.p: Alumax Inc and Germany-based Eduard Hueck GmbH & Co said on Thursday that they are in talks for Alumax to acquire Eduard Hueck.

The companies said that negotiations are ongoing and that any transaction is dependent upon the execution of a mutually satisfactory definitive agreement, regulatory approval and the approvals of Alumax's board and all selling parties.
The companies said in a joint statement that they plan to maintain the Hueck brand name for aluminum profile systems and to retain the current management of Hueck.
Hueck is a family business based in Ludenscheid, Germany, with subsidiaries in and outside of Germany that serve as distribution centers.
Hueck is a leading manufacturer of aluminum architectural products in Europe, with 1995 revenues of more than 340 million marks, the companies said.
Alumax posted 1995 revenues of more than $2.9 billion and ended 1995 with assets topping $3.1 billion.
